race.comment: Several here shouldn't be maidens for long. The scratchings have taken out some of the chances and looks a good race for REFUSE TO CURTSY (9). The filly is second-up and last time in that state was in the VRC Sires. Fourth at Seymour fresh this time in after a long break and extra trip a plus. REGAL BANTER (10) ran very well on debut at Mornington almost a year ago when runner-up. Was back in work ninth autumn and didn't race, but presents on the back of three hit-outs so should be ready for this. MUSICAL JOURNEY (6) wound up strongly at debut and looks tough to stop here. BLOOMIN' RICH (1) is a promising type who was fourth on debut and is in the mix.
